title: Compatible regular presentations of a map of complete local rings
statement: Let $f:(A,\mathfrak m_A)\to(B,\mathfrak m_B)$ be a local homomorphism ($f(\mathfrak m_A)\subseteq\mathfrak m_B$) of Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], complete for their maximal-ideal-adic topologies [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Then there exist regular local rings $(R,\mathfrak m_R)$ and $(S,\mathfrak m_S)$ [def-weil-regular-scheme], complete for their maximal-ideal-adic topologies, surjective local ring homomorphisms $q:R\to A$, $v:S\to B$, and a local ring homomorphism $u:R\to S$ with $vu=fq$. The map $q$ induces an isomorphism $R/\mathfrak m_R\cong A/\mathfrak m_A$. There is a regular system of parameters $t_1,\ldots,t_d$ of $R$ (a set of $d=\dim R$ generators of $\mathfrak m_R$) whose images $u(t_1),\ldots,u(t_d)$ extend to a regular system of parameters of $S$. In particular $R\to S$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and $S/\mathfrak m_RS$ is regular local.

source.place: More on Algebra, Tag 07NN, lemma-embed-map-Noetherian-complete-local-rings, statement and proof. Only its regularity and parameter conclusions are stated here. The residue-field isomorphism for q is given by the proof: R is a power series ring over the residue field of A in characteristic zero or over a Cohen ring with that residue field otherwise; the displayed surjection induces that field map.
